prompt: Exactly as in the image: on the old wooden table in the dim godown, the Munchly Masala Chips packet stands still, its printed design unchanged; in the brass hourglass beside it the last thin trickle of sand runs out; dust drifts slowly through the cool blue moonlight from the high window.
